scope: One frozen combined controller on all nine fall directions: nine nominal and 45 fresh perturbed starts at two native timesteps (108 full 24 s trials). Same four motors, 120 mm plant, continuous motor dynamics, original standing gate and no retry. No new recovery weights, impact falls, terrain variation, varied initial hip poses, sensor uncertainty or hardware qualification.
